{{Vanilla}}
'''Natural regeneration''' is turned off in [[Matcha Flavoured]]. A player's [[health]] never recovers on its own, however full they are; it has to be restored with [[food]] and other healing sources.

== Mechanics ==
When a player first joins a world, the pack sets the game rule <code>natural_health_regeneration</code> to <code>false</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/gamerules.mcfunction}}</ref> The rule is set from the reward of the root advancement, so it can be turned back on with <code>/gamerule</code>, but it is set to <code>false</code> again whenever a new player joins or a player first joins after the pack is updated.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/first_load.mcfunction}}</ref>

The [[hunger]] bar is also hidden and held just above the sprinting threshold, so even with the game rule on, the food level would not reach the level vanilla needs for regeneration.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/manage_hunger.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Healing instead ===
* Most [[food]] heals through {{MCW|Instant Health}} or {{EffectLink|Regeneration}}.
* {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}}, dropped by zombies and their variants, heals the player when picked up.
* [[Warding Stone|Warding stones]] heal nearby players.
* A [[Crystal Heart|crystal heart]] heals with Regeneration XI when used.

== Trivia ==
* The pack's README lists "Natural Regeneration has been removed" and "Hunger has been removed" among its major features.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref>
* In the design video, the developer says the change was inspired by the Beta hunger system, where eating healed the player directly.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=I do think though that the hunger system in beta was really fun. So, for Matcha Flavored, I decided that the hunger and healing should be thrown out entirely.}}</ref>
